title: Volley Machine Readiness
description: The supervisor's verdict on one machine, published retained to volley/_system/machines/<name>/readiness by the supervisor only. The machine record is the machine's statement about itself; this verdict needs the supervisor's config and version, so it has its own topic. States only, never a secret. See spec section 4.6.15.

name.description: The machine's name (the topic's second-to-last level).

ready.description: true when no blocking check fails: the machine can run an agent (tunnel up or local, toolchain on the non-interactive ssh PATH, versions the supervisor accepts, the wave repo cloned, GitHub and Claude signed in).

reasons.description: One human-readable line per thing that keeps the machine from being ready; empty when ready.

drain.description: hosts.<name>.drain: the machine takes no new placements; its running agents finish.

max_agents.description: The machine's agent cap (hosts.<name>.max_agents; the supervisor's own machine: hard_ceiling).

placed.description: Live supervised agents on the machine, plus placements reserved for it that have not spawned yet.

path_ok.description: Whether claude and bun resolve on the machine's non-interactive ssh PATH (the one an agent's tmux session gets); null when not probed yet.

requirements.description: What the supervisor requires of the machine, so its doctor can compare and provision.

volley.description: The supervisor's own volley version: a peer's must match it.

bun.description: The lowest bun version the supervisor accepts.

sharing.description: The supervisor's per-item sharing modes (spec section 4.6.11), which the machine's doctor applies to its own Claude profile.

heavy.description: Per lease pool that sets per_machine: the leases the machine's holders hold, and the pool's per-machine cap (spec section 4.6.5).

usage.description: The Claude account the machine's agents run under (spec section 4.6.12: <acct>@<host> for a peer) and its 5-hour usage; null while unknown.

eligible.description: Whether placement may put a new task there now: ready, not draining, under max_agents, not overloaded, enough memory and disk, Claude usage headroom.

ineligible_reason.description: Why eligible is false, in one line; required then, absent otherwise.
